programme.title: Aventurat e sirenës së vogël
programme.desc: Marina, një sirenë e vetmuar, është mërzitur me jetën nën ujë. Dëshira e saj më e madhe është që të ketë këmbë. Një ditë ajo shkon tek shtriga e ujit e cila i jep një bilbil magjik që sa herë i fryn të kthen në njeri ose sirenë.

programme.title: Aventurat e sirenës së vogël
programme.desc: Marina, një sirenë e vetmuar, është mërzitur me jetën nën ujë. Dëshira e saj më e madhe është që të ketë këmbë. Një ditë ajo shkon tek shtriga e ujit e cila i jep një bilbil magjik që sa herë i fryn të kthen në njeri ose sirenë.

programme.title: Qielli i saj i kaltër
programme.desc: Pas humbjes së prindërve, Akane fillon të kujdeset për motrën e vogël Aoi, madje për të, ajo refuzon ftesën e shokut të saj Shinosuke për tu shkolluar në Tokio. Por pas 13 vitesh nga takimi i tyre i fundit, ai rikthehet në rrethana shumë misterioze...

programme.title: Përbindëshi im i ëmbël
programme.desc: Princeshë Barbara arratiset nga palati mbretëror sepse nuk do të martohet me postierin i cili do vetëm pushtet....Por Bugi, një përbindësh shumë i ëmbël, e ndihmon Barbarën të rikthehet që të shpëtojë mbretërinë e saj...

programme.title: Qeni rokstar 2: Në park ka një festë
programme.desc: Kur kitarristi i talentuar Bodi dhe grupi i tij, largohen nga Mali me dëborë për të shoqëruar në turne yllin e pop-it, dhelprën Lil’, ata do të mësojnë se Fama, e ka gjithmon një çmim...

programme.title: Mbretëreria e dëborës
programme.desc: Ai është një qytet i rrethuar me akull. Në krye të tij qëndron Mbretëresha e dëborës, e cila ka ngrirë ndjenjat e të gjithë njërëzve. Por është ende një vajzë e vogël, me zemrën plot dashuri, e cila niset për të shpëtuar vëllain e saj Kai.

programme.title: Tarzan
programme.desc: Tarzani dhe Xhejni do të përballen me një ushtri mercenarësh të dërguar nga një njeri i lig që mori kompaninë e prindërve të Tarzanit pasi ata vdiqën në një aksident me avion.

programme.desc: Marina, një sirenë e vetmuar, është mërzitur me jetën nën ujë. Dëshira e saj më e madhe është që të ketë këmbë. Një ditë ajo shkon tek shtriga e ujit e cila i jep një bilbil magjik që sa herë i fryn të kthen në njeri ose sirenë.

programme.title: Aventurat e sirenës së vogël
programme.desc: Marina, një sirenë e vetmuar, është mërzitur me jetën nën ujë. Dëshira e saj më e madhe është që të ketë këmbë. Një ditë ajo shkon tek shtriga e ujit e cila i jep një bilbil magjik që sa herë i fryn të kthen në njeri ose sirenë.

programme.title: Djali Fantazmë
programme.desc: Kjo është historia e një djali shumë të vecantë me fuqi të mbinatyrshme: është i padukshëm. Edhe pse është vetëm 11 vjec, ai ka vetëm 24 orë kohë, për të shpëtuar Nju Jorkun nga një njeri shumë i lig.

programme.title: Krishtlindjet e Olivias
programme.desc: Olivia një derrkuce 8 vjecare, u nis drejt polit të veriut vetëm për ti shkuar në ndihmë babagjyshit dhe shumë fëmijëve të tjerë nëpër botë. Sepse ajo e di që, rëndësia e festave nuk janë thjesht dhuratat, por dashuria që ti dhuron...

programme.title: Mister në trenin e kafshëve
programme.desc: Një vjedhje misterioze ndodh në trenin e kafshëve dhe të gjithë janë të dyshuar. Vetëm Klara, Gavin dhe detektivja Agatha mund të zbulojnë të vërtetën. Aventura enigmatike zhvillohet në çdo vagon, ku çdo detaj mund të jetë çelësi i misterit.

programme.title: Agjenti Ali
programme.desc: Pasi u rekrutua aksidentalisht si spiun, 12-vjeçari Ali tani është rritur dhe ka një vend pune në agjencinë sekrete MATA. Tani, ai duhet të mbrojë qytetin futurist të Siberajas nga kërcënimet e jashtme...

programme.title: Sindi, Princesha Zanë
programme.desc: Sindi zgjohet në pyllin e zanave. Ajo njihet me tri zana që fluturojnë mbi mbretërinë e bukur që rrezikohet nga një magjistar i lig. Sindi dhe zanat nisin një aventurë të jashtëzakonshme për të ndihmuar mbretërinë.

programme.title: Shtëpia e zhurmshme: Filmi
programme.desc: Familja më e zhurmshme në botë vjen me një aventurë të re. Këtë herë ata do të nisen drejt Skocisë, për tu njohur me historinë e tyre familjare. Kështjella, dragonj, mbretër dhe argëtim I paharrueshëm...

programme.desc: Ates, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. Mercan, already promised to Nezir, is thrust into a battle she never chose, while Ates binds her to him believing she is the key to his revenge. programme.title: In and Out
programme.desc: Të rejat nga showbizi, intervista pse jo edhe thashetheme të gjitha këto tashmë do të vijnë përmes emisionit më të ri që ka nisur transmetimin në RTV21 , “In and Out”, nën udhëheqjen e Granit Miftarit. Të mërkurën të enjten dhe të premten duke filluar nga ora 19: 30, Graniti do të jetë pranë jush për të dhënë më të rejat rreth personaliteteve të njohura, qoftë për karrierën e tyre e edhe për jetën private. Në edicionin e parë që u transmetua mbrëmë, mysafir i parë ishtë këngëtarja, Vesa Smolica e cila foli për pjesëmarrjen e saj në festivalin “Kënga Magjike”.

Në edicionin e parë që u transmetua mbrëmë, mysafir i parë ishtë këngëtarja, Vesa Smolica e cila foli për pjesëmarrjen e saj në festivalin “Kënga Magjike”.

programme.title: Monsters: Truth Behind the Myths
programme.desc: This is the story of why humankind has believed in demons for centuries, stretching back to the ancient world and the early church, then evolving through the 19th and 20th centuries up to the present day.

programme.title: Bombardimi i Pompeit
programme.desc: Pompeii. The world’s most astonishing historical time capsule. Once a vibrant and sprawling Roman town, it was buried under ash and rock for centuries following the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD. But the town was almost destroyed a second time - during WW2.

programme.title: Kështjella e Fundit e Hitlerit
programme.desc: On his first day of command, American Colonel George Mabry leads a broken battalion through the unforgiving Hurtgen Forest, to take the Roer River dams before the Nazis flood the area. The mission will take them through booby traps, minefields, bunkers, and enemy ambushes, as they fight one of the most gruelling battlefields of World War 2.

programme.title: Kështjella e Fundit e Hitlerit,
programme.desc: Ndërsa fundi i Luftës së Dytë Botërore po afrohet, forcat naziste luftojnë deri në fund për të ndaluar ushtritë aleate të çlirojnë Evropën.

programme.title: Rregullimet më të vështira
programme.desc: Gjithandej jemi të rrethuar me teknologji te avancuar. Por cfarë ndodh kur gjatë përdorimit, këta përbindësha të teknologjisë pësojnë difekte? Si riparohen? Kush janë vështirësitë që hasen për të riparuar defektet që u ndodhin këtyre mekanizmave...

programme.title: Guxo ose vdis
programme.desc: Këtu do të shihni disa prej situatave më të rrezikshme të xhiruara ndonjëherë e do të testoni njohuritë tuaja të mbijetesës. A do të mund të mbijetoni?

programme.title: Shpëtim në Akull
programme.desc: Një serial reality tv që ndjek një grup shoferësh kamionesh në malet e Norvegjisë që janë ndër terrenet më të rrezikshme të Europës.

programme.title: Doktorët e Makinave
programme.desc: Duke vazhduar misionin e tyre për të shpëtuar çdo makinë klasike të prishur që mund të kenë në dorë.

programme.title: Gjeniu i Rrugës
programme.desc: Një serial me pyetje mbi inxhinjerinë dhe që sfidon publikun global që të zgjedhë përfundimin e dhhur për eksperimente të jashtëzakonshme.

programme.desc: Gjithandej jemi të rrethuar me teknologji te avancuar. Por cfarë ndodh kur gjatë përdorimit, këta përbindësha të teknologjisë pësojnë difekte? Si riparohen? Kush janë vështirësitë që hasen për të riparuar defektet që u ndodhin këtyre mekanizmave...

programme.title: Vepra Të Braktisura
programme.desc: A Texan retreat, frequented by the rich and infamous; a tropical island complex in Brazil, the scene of a dramatic uprising; a magical stronghold that inspired an Irish national hero; and the gateway to a powerful ancient order in South Korea. Standing on the brink of collapse, some soon to be lost forever, these ruined sites have suffered through devastating natural disasters, years of violent wars, and events far more surprising. Within these decaying structures are the echoes of history – they speak of death and destruction, but also human ingenuity and endeavour; each haunted shell now ready to be unmasked and tell its own unique story.

programme.title: Kapja e Trafikantit
programme.desc: Miliona njerëz hyjnë në kufijtë amerikanë çdo vit nga aeroportet, dhe mes tyre janë të fshehur shumë njerëz me qëllime të këqija.

programme.title: Yukon Rescue
programme.desc: As winter tightens its icy grip, the small, isolated community of West Dawson finds itself completely cut off from emergency services. Alone, Ray faces a string of dangerous solo vehicle-retrieval missions on a storm-battered highway.

programme.title: Shpëtim në Akull
programme.desc: Një serial reality tv që ndjek një grup shoferësh kamionesh në malet e Norvegjisë që janë ndër terrenet më të rrezikshme të Europës.

programme.title: Jeta Nën Zero: Aalaskasit e Parë
programme.desc: Popujt indigjenë të Alaskës duhet të lundrojnë në një klimë në ndryshim duke përdorur vlerat e së kaluarës si një udhëzues për të ardhmen e tyre.

programme.title: Toronto Airport: Uncovered
programme.desc: Emergency at Toronto International as a plane crash lands. The resulting shut down sees flights cancelled and diverted, pushing teams to their limit.

programme.title: Hetimi i Aksidenteve Ajrore
programme.desc: Një pamje e detajuar e arsyeve dhe hetimeve në disa prej rasteve më të njohura të defekteve ajrore në historinë e aviacionit.

programme.title: Kapja e Trafikantit
programme.desc: Miliona njerëz hyjnë në kufijtë amerikanë çdo vit nga aeroportet, dhe mes tyre janë të fshehur shumë njerëz me qëllime të këqija.

programme.title: Thesaret e Humbur Të Majave
programme.desc: The new treasure map leads to discovery of a lost fortress that paints a picture of a civilisation at war. A sacred altar is unearthed after 1500 years buried in a ruined temple, revealing secrets of the legendary Maya Snake King uprising. And Albert Lin travels to the most remote jungle corner of the Maya world, where cutting edge laser technology is helping to reveal evidence of a forgotten war.

programme.title: Vepra Të Braktisura
programme.desc: A castle-like ruin you might expect to see in the Scottish Highlands, in full view of Manhattan; a military stronghold in Japan built in response to American gunboat diplomacy; a picturesque bay that hides a vast mountain complex; and a ruined site that helped decode one of the world’s most enduring mysteries. Standing on the brink of collapse, some soon to be lost forever, these ruined sites have suffered through devastating natural disasters, years of violent wars, and events far more surprising. Within these decaying structures are the echoes of history – they speak of death and destruction, but also human ingenuity and endeavour; each haunted shell now ready to be unmasked and tell its own unique story.

programme.title: Kështjella e Fundit e Hitlerit
programme.desc: As Allied forces fight to break out from the D-Day beaches, American Captain Matt Urban is badly wounded in a German tank assault. But determined to return to his battalion, he makes it to the front, climbs aboard a Sherman, and leads a daring charge through hedgerow country. programme.title: Hitler’s Gold
programme.desc: Munich, September the 12th, 1919. History is about to be changed by a penniless army corporal thirsty to avenge his adoptive motherland. 13 years later, he will be saluted as the savior of the German nation. His name is Adolf Hitler.

programme.title: Hitler’s Gold
programme.desc: Germany, 1937. By imposing his national economic policies by brute force, Adolf Hitler appears to be fulfilling his promise of returning Germany to prosperity within only 4 years. But there was an altogether more sinister side to this economic recovery and even as Germany was basking in the glow of her newfound confidence, Hitler and his cronies were selling her soul. In this episode, we reveal how the Nazis took absolute power over Germany with the financial backing of its industrial elite, and how Hitler would repay them by commissioning them the rearmament of the country, financed by an ingenious credit scheme created by financial wizard Hjalmar Schacht. We reveal how Gustav Krupp von Bohlen became the main industrial figure in the country, along with his financial contributions to the Führer, who himself made a fortune with his own publishing house and royalties. And finally, we reveal how Herman Göering’s plans for autarky would make way for Flick’s and IG Farben’s domination of the Reich economy, but at the same time, lead the country to the verge of economic collapse, and the need for expansion that would inevitably cause the deadliest conflict in the history of mankind.

programme.title: Top Guns: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Defensive dogfighting proves the toughest test yet, as the students must avoid being shot down by their battle-hardened instructors.

programme.title: Gjeniu i Rrugës
programme.desc: Një serial me pyetje mbi inxhinjerinë dhe që sfidon publikun global që të zgjedhë përfundimin e dhhur për eksperimente të jashtëzakonshme.

programme.title: Shkenca e Idiotit
programme.desc: Ky progtram kombinon faktet e ftohta shkencore me disa prej veprimeve më të çmendura, më spektakolare e që shkaktojnë më shumë dhimbje

programme.title: Një Shkëmb i Çuditshëm
programme.desc: Historia e jashtëzakonshme e Tokës dhe pse ajo është e veçantë dhe në mënyrë unike e mbushur me jetë në mes të një hapsire kozmike kryesisht të panjohur por e ashpër; astronautët tregojnë historinë e Tokës përmes një këndvështrimi unik.

programme.title: The Abyss: Rise and Fall of the Nazis
programme.desc: How could a crisis-ridden democracy turn into an apocalypse with war and genocide? The rise and fall of National Socialism is told from an international perspective to offer a new comprehensive view on German history between 1918 and 1948.

programme.title: Kështjella e Fundit e Hitlerit
programme.desc: As the war nears its end, an unorthodox, top secret commando unit launches a nighttime raid on a shallow lake in Northern Italy, to divert German forces from the next major Allied offensive. Led by Danish Major Anders Lassen — a fearless, hard-drinking brawler with an amphetamine addiction — they find themselves pinned down in unforgiving terrain, and must push through murderous German opposition, while the fate of the entire Allied assault hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Shkenca e Budallait
programme.sub-title: Rrota të mëdha, probleme të mëdha
programme.desc: Ky progtram kombinon faktet e ftohta shkencore me disa prej veprimeve më të çmendura, më spektakolare e që shkaktojnë më shumë dhimbje

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: Delta Flight 191 encountered a gathering storm on its journey from Fort Lauderdale to Dallas-Fort Worth. On final approach, a sudden downburst made a safe landing impossible. The crew lost control of the plane, crashing short of the runway. This episode traces the meteorological breakthroughs learned from this tragedy.

programme.title: Kapja e Trafikantit
programme.desc: Miliona njerëz hyjnë në kufijtë amerikanë çdo vit nga aeroportet, dhe mes tyre janë të fshehur shumë njerëz me qëllime të këqija.

programme.title: Këtë Nuk e Dija
programme.desc: Scientists Richard and Jonny investigate what is stronger - wood or steel? Plus, can computer games teach Richard how to fly a real helicopter?

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Railroad
programme.desc: Train crews in the Rockies must haul their 15,000 ton grain train through ice-encrusted tunnels to make their delivery on time.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Railroad
programme.desc: A spike in the temperature threatens Rocky Mountain’s shipments. The team struggle to shore up the track after mudslides and washouts devastate the rail-line.

programme.title: Mutant Weather
programme.desc: Warmer weather makes storms more unpredictable; with sudden downburst thunderstorms and random lightning strikes, rogue storm events are becoming more frequent and widespread as temperatures rise.

programme.title: Decoding History’s Prophecies
programme.desc: A prophecy born on a Korean mountainside ignites the ambitions of a controversial figure with a worldwide following. An eerie prediction of inclement weather launches a woman of humble origins into the spotlight. And the fate of empires hangs in the balance as ancient Romans await the prophetic pecks of sacred chickens.

programme.title: Voyagers: Exploring Pacific Waters
programme.desc: 4000 years ago, fearless voyagers sail into the unexplored Pacific Ocean searching for islands to start new lives on. They overcome merciless seas and settle islands from Guam to Vanuatu. Guided by their ancestors’ stories, they become master navigators. but after they reach the islands of Fiji, Samoa and Tonga, they struggle to find new islands.

programme.title: Voyagers: Exploring Pacific Waters
programme.desc: 1000 years ago, Pacific voyagers set sail. No one has found new land for a millennium, but new ingenious double-hull canoes unlock the Pacific and they discover Tahiti! From there, brave voyagers follow the stars, birds and whales to Easter Island, Hawai’i and New Zealand. But when Europeans reach the Pacific, their world will change forever.

programme.title: Qytetet e Humbura me Albert Lin
programme.desc: Albert Lin niset në një aventurë globale nga thellësitë e Detit të Zi deri tek Andet peruane, në kërkim të origjinës së rrëfenjave mbi Përmbytjen e Madhe.

programme.title: Qytetet e Humbura me Albert Lin

programme.title: Yukon Rescue
programme.desc: Avalanche technicians race to repair a remote weather station before an incoming storm. The escalating risks force them to carry out a bombing mission to flush out a dangerous buildup of snow above the Klondike Highway. Meanwhile, Dawson City is left reeling from the loss of the person they rely on the most to keep them safe.

programme.title: Cape Epic 2019
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer’s calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Paragliding World Cup
programme.desc: Superfinalja e Kupës së Botës në Paragliding u zhvillua në Roldanillo, Kolumbi, me dhjetë ditë fluturime konkurruese në nivel të lartë në një nga vendet më të mira të paraglidingut në botë. Njëqind e njëzet e dy pilotë morën pjesë, përfshirë 18 fitues të mëparshëm të përgjithshëm të Kupës së Botës dhe 12 fituese të Kupës së Botës për Femra, duke e renditur atë si një nga garat më të vështira që janë përballur ndonjëherë me njëri-tjetrin. Të pezulluar në ajër, ky sport aventurier përfshin gara në distanca të gjata, ku pilotët duhet të jenë ekspertë në kuptimin e ndikimit të terrenit në kushtet e motit.

programme.title: Better Than Four
programme.desc: Initially a bi-weekly (26×26’) sports series with a difference, ‘Better Than Four’ brings viewers all the action from all things two-wheeled. As well as profiling past, present and future heroes of cycling, ‘Better Than Four’ includes news features and highlights from the very latest events. Each episode is also packed with tips and tricks to try at home, as well as reviews of the latest kit, equipment and cycling films. Changing gears from traditional cycling coverage, ‘Better Than Four’ takes viewers to new, exotic locations, from the volcano bike-ride in Bali to jungle biking around the Mayan temples of South America. Each episode will include up to 3 segments covering cycling and biking events from all over the world. With amazing footage and commentary from experienced cyclists, daredevil skills and awe-inspiring camerawork, this groundbreaking show is a must for cycling enthusiasts and novices alike.

programme.title: Salomon Gore - Tex Maxi Race
programme.desc: More than just a trail-race the Maxi Race takes runners on an 85km journey around the unique landscape of Lake Annecy, France. Athletes choose the Ultra, Vertical-Race or Marathon, pushing themselves to develop mountain skills and face their own personal challenges. The Salomon Gore-Tex Maxi Race is one of the best and most demanding trail running events, staged in the stunning lake and mountain scenery of the Haute Savoie.

programme.title: Cape Epic 2019
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer’s calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race 2019
programme.desc: Gara andaluze e biçikletave është gara kryesore e biçikletave malore në Spanjë, e cila përbëhet nga gjashtë etapa dhe zgjat gjashtë ditë. Ritmi i garës nuk bie asnjë minutë gjatë këtyre gjashtë etapave. Në provën e fundit, çiklistët ngjiten në 1396 metra lartësi në mitikun Reventon dhe kalojnë përmes Trassierra-s, pastaj zbresin dhe përfundojnë në itinerarin e paharrueshëm Santo-Domingo. Një gabim në shtigjet shkëmbore do të thotë fundi i garës. Fituesit e edicionit të 9-të ishin spanjolli David Valero në garën e meshkujve dhe norvegjezja Hildegunn Hovdenak në atë të femrave.

programme.title: Better Than Four
programme.desc: Initially a bi-weekly (26×26’) sports series with a difference, ‘Better Than Four’ brings viewers all the action from all things two-wheeled. As well as profiling past, present and future heroes of cycling, ‘Better Than Four’ includes news features and highlights from the very latest events. Each episode is also packed with tips and tricks to try at home, as well as reviews of the latest kit, equipment and cycling films. Changing gears from traditional cycling coverage, ‘Better Than Four’ takes viewers to new, exotic locations, from the volcano bike-ride in Bali to jungle biking around the Mayan temples of South America. Each episode will include up to 3 segments covering cycling and biking events from all over the world. With amazing footage and commentary from experienced cyclists, daredevil skills and awe-inspiring camerawork, this groundbreaking show is a must for cycling enthusiasts and novices alike.

programme.title: Audi Winter Games
programme.desc: Stunning scenery, world’s best talent and Kiwi hospitality is set to be showcased to a global audience with Winter Games New Zealand carrying out a diverse event yet again. Winter Olympic, Paralympic and X Games stars are heading to New Zealand’s Southern Alps once again for the first major winter sports championships of the season. They compete for glory in varied sports such as freestyle skiing, snowboarding, alpine skiing, cross-country skiing and curling. The Winter Games New Zealand are one of the world’s top five winter sports competitions and the only one in the southern hemisphere. They are also New Zealand’s largest recurring sports event. It’s a uniquely Kiwi experience that athletes, coaches, judges and spectators all rave about. The relaxed atmosphere, friendly people, sporting action and festival fun with live acts and DJs – host towns Queenstown and Wanaka look forward to the biggest party on southern snow!

programme.title: Paragliding World Cup
programme.desc: Superfinalja e Kupës së Botës në Paragliding u zhvillua në Roldanillo, Kolumbi, me dhjetë ditë fluturime konkurruese në nivel të lartë në një nga vendet më të mira të paraglidingut në botë. Njëqind e njëzet e dy pilotë morën pjesë, përfshirë 18 fitues të mëparshëm të përgjithshëm të Kupës së Botës dhe 12 fituese të Kupës së Botës për Femra, duke e renditur atë si një nga garat më të vështira që janë përballur ndonjëherë me njëri-tjetrin. Të pezulluar në ajër, ky sport aventurier përfshin gara në distanca të gjata, ku pilotët duhet të jenë ekspertë në kuptimin e ndikimit të terrenit në kushtet e motit.

programme.title: Cape Epic 2019
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer’s calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Paragliding World Cup
programme.desc: Superfinalja e Kupës së Botës në Paragliding u zhvillua në Roldanillo, Kolumbi, me dhjetë ditë fluturime konkurruese në nivel të lartë në një nga vendet më të mira të paraglidingut në botë. Njëqind e njëzet e dy pilotë morën pjesë, përfshirë 18 fitues të mëparshëm të përgjithshëm të Kupës së Botës dhe 12 fituese të Kupës së Botës për Femra, duke e renditur atë si një nga garat më të vështira që janë përballur ndonjëherë me njëri-tjetrin. Të pezulluar në ajër, ky sport aventurier përfshin gara në distanca të gjata, ku pilotët duhet të jenë ekspertë në kuptimin e ndikimit të terrenit në kushtet e motit.

programme.title: Cape Epic 2025
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer’s calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Better Than Four
programme.desc: Initially a bi-weekly (26×26’) sports series with a difference, ‘Better Than Four’ brings viewers all the action from all things two-wheeled. As well as profiling past, present and future heroes of cycling, ‘Better Than Four’ includes news features and highlights from the very latest events. Each episode is also packed with tips and tricks to try at home, as well as reviews of the latest kit, equipment and cycling films. Changing gears from traditional cycling coverage, ‘Better Than Four’ takes viewers to new, exotic locations, from the volcano bike-ride in Bali to jungle biking around the Mayan temples of South America. Each episode will include up to 3 segments covering cycling and biking events from all over the world. With amazing footage and commentary from experienced cyclists, daredevil skills and awe-inspiring camerawork, this groundbreaking show is a must for cycling enthusiasts and novices alike.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race 2019
programme.desc: Gara andaluze e biçikletave është gara kryesore e biçikletave malore në Spanjë, e cila përbëhet nga gjashtë etapa dhe zgjat gjashtë ditë. Ritmi i garës nuk bie asnjë minutë gjatë këtyre gjashtë etapave. Në provën e fundit, çiklistët ngjiten në 1396 metra lartësi në mitikun Reventon dhe kalojnë përmes Trassierra-s, pastaj zbresin dhe përfundojnë në itinerarin e paharrueshëm Santo-Domingo. Një gabim në shtigjet shkëmbore do të thotë fundi i garës. Fituesit e edicionit të 9-të ishin spanjolli David Valero në garën e meshkujve dhe norvegjezja Hildegunn Hovdenak në atë të femrave.

programme.title: Cape Epic 2019
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer’s calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Salomon Gore - Tex Maxi Race
programme.desc: More than just a trail-race the Maxi Race takes runners on an 85km journey around the unique landscape of Lake Annecy, France. Athletes choose the Ultra, Vertical-Race or Marathon, pushing themselves to develop mountain skills and face their own personal challenges. The Salomon Gore-Tex Maxi Race is one of the best and most demanding trail running events, staged in the stunning lake and mountain scenery of the Haute Savoie.

programme.title: Wild Spirits
programme.desc: Wild Spirits ju sjell më të rejat nga sportet ekstreme, duke përfshirë intervista ekskluzive, mbulim unik dhe të specializuar të ngjarjeve, si dhe një vështrim mbi yjet e ardhshëm të aksionit. Wild Spirits është një program sportiv, një emision për interesat e meshkujve dhe një revistë e kulturës alternative, të gjitha të ndërthurura në një të vetëm.

programme.title: Better Than Four
programme.desc: Initially a bi-weekly (26×26’) sports series with a difference, ‘Better Than Four’ brings viewers all the action from all things two-wheeled. As well as profiling past, present and future heroes of cycling, ‘Better Than Four’ includes news features and highlights from the very latest events. Each episode is also packed with tips and tricks to try at home, as well as reviews of the latest kit, equipment and cycling films. Changing gears from traditional cycling coverage, ‘Better Than Four’ takes viewers to new, exotic locations, from the volcano bike-ride in Bali to jungle biking around the Mayan temples of South America. Each episode will include up to 3 segments covering cycling and biking events from all over the world. With amazing footage and commentary from experienced cyclists, daredevil skills and awe-inspiring camerawork, this groundbreaking show is a must for cycling enthusiasts and novices alike.

programme.title: Aussie Racer
programme.desc: Hosted by Australian motorsport legend Sandy Bowman. In 2013 Sandy Bowman and his navigator Daniel Hardman destroyed their off road race car in a massive crash. They have set out to build a new one, which is a huge undertaking, so to stay entertained Sandy and Daniel decided to compete in other forms of racing whilst the new car is being developed. Every episode Sandy and Daniel enter different events and wholeheartedly get into the spirit of that form of racing.

programme.title: Cape Epic 2019
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer’s calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: FREERIDE WORLD TOUR 2018
programme.desc: The Freeride World Tour (FWT) expands to Asia! The season kick-off of the world’s most important freeride series for skiers and snowboarders will be held at Hakuba (JPN), the first time ever the FWT stops in the Far East. The second stage of the tour will also guest at a new location, champagne powder paradise Kicking Horse near Golden, British Columbia (CAN). The series continues with the well-proven spectacular slopes of Vallnord-Arcalís (AND), Fieberbrunn (AUT), and Verbier (SUI).

programme.title: Salomon Gore - Tex Maxi Race
programme.desc: More than just a trail-race the Maxi Race takes runners on an 85km journey around the unique landscape of Lake Annecy, France. Athletes choose the Ultra, Vertical-Race or Marathon, pushing themselves to develop mountain skills and face their own personal challenges. The Salomon Gore-Tex Maxi Race is one of the best and most demanding trail running events, staged in the stunning lake and mountain scenery of the Haute Savoie.

programme.title: Cape Epic 2019
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer’s calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Better Than Four
programme.desc: Initially a bi-weekly (26×26’) sports series with a difference, ‘Better Than Four’ brings viewers all the action from all things two-wheeled. As well as profiling past, present and future heroes of cycling, ‘Better Than Four’ includes news features and highlights from the very latest events. Each episode is also packed with tips and tricks to try at home, as well as reviews of the latest kit, equipment and cycling films. Changing gears from traditional cycling coverage, ‘Better Than Four’ takes viewers to new, exotic locations, from the volcano bike-ride in Bali to jungle biking around the Mayan temples of South America. Each episode will include up to 3 segments covering cycling and biking events from all over the world. With amazing footage and commentary from experienced cyclists, daredevil skills and awe-inspiring camerawork, this groundbreaking show is a must for cycling enthusiasts and novices alike.

programme.title: Cape Epic 2019
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer’s calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Unstoppable: The Fentanyl Epidemic
programme.desc: Canadians’ attention has been briefly grabbed by the headline: the story an abnormally high number of overdose deaths caused by a drug called fentanyl. It merited a few days attention and then was pushed off the stage by other concerns. What Canadians failed to appreciate was that those few headlines offered a foreboding glimpse of what might be one of the most destructive waves of illegal drugs to hit North America since Pablo Escobar flooded the continent with cheap and powerful cocaine. Fentanyl is a killer. And fentanyl isn’t just preying on the addict population of this country. Its victims are also Canada’s unsuspecting middle-class. And the epidemic is showing no signs of letting up. In fact all signs point to the death count rising as more and more powerful versions of this drug seep into the country.The result, Canadians have no idea what’s “slouching” towards them in the near future. Through the eyes of four insiders in the fentanyl industry, Dam Builder Productions will take the audience inside this world in way that will enlighten, outrage, and even fascinate.

programme.title: Remote Control War
programme.desc: The current campaigns in Iraq and Afghanistan are the world’s first Robotic War, with over 7,000 robots in the air and 12,000 on the ground. Warfare has been revolutionised in a monumental shift. Mankind’s five thousand year monopoly on war is breaking down. Robotic war is here.

programme.title: Trouble in Lemur Land
programme.desc: High up in the mountains of north-eastern Madagascar lives one of the world’s most critically endangered primates. There are less than a thousand Silky Sifakas alive today and this area of remote rainforest, known as Marojejy-Anjanaharibe-Sud, is their only home.In the past, the rugged terrain here kept the Silkies relatively safe but things are now changing at an alarming pace. This magical place is under serious threat from illegal logging operations as international demand for highly sought-after rosewood and ebony increases. Unscrupulous logging gangs are encroaching on the Silkies’ last remaining habitat.‘Trouble in Lemur Land’ follows two men, an American primatologist and a Malagasy conservationist, on their quest to protect this rare species, at the same time providing a rare glimpse into the life of this extraordinarily beautiful and graceful animal.The film centres around the arrival of two babies in the group - a glimmer of hope in an otherwise desperate situation. Lemur reproduction rates are slow and Silkies only mate one day in the year, so it is a very special moment when primatologist Erik Patel sees the newborns for the first time. He has a permanent camp on the outskirts of their last remaining territory and we are given a rare glimpse into this intimate, close-knit group as the babies develop in the sanctuary of the forest canopy.Meanwhile, taking advantage of long-term political instability, the loggers are steadily extracting Madagascar’s rosewood for export to China. Although they are well armed and highly motivated, conservationist Desire Rabary is not afraid to confront them, regardless of the risks. He heads up a network of local people who play a vital role in the survival of the forest and its lemurs. Over the past five years, he has worked hard to actively expose the loggers’ illegal trail of destruction but, as this film reveals, the heart of the problem starts on his own doorstep.This 50-minute HD film brings the forest to life, with stunning images of many of its other species, including the striking helmet vanga bird, white-fronted brown lemur, red-bellied lemur, green tree frogs, panther chameleons and the elusive fossa. This treasure trove of endemic Madagascan wildlife is a timely reminder of what we stand to lose if the environmental issues so critical to their survival are not urgently addressed.

programme.title: In the Darkness
programme.desc: An immersion in the heart of the biggest West-African prison: Abidjan. Located out of sight at the border of the Banco forest, this prison host 5,000 inmates but has capacity for 1,500. With the inmates’ help, life inside is organized, and a degree of stability exists.

programme.title: Colonies Under the Sea

programme.title: Mefloquine: The Anti-malarial Drug Investigation
programme.desc: Developed by the US Army after Vietnam to combat malaria in troops, Mefloquine became available to the public in the 90s. However, in the following decades it became most well-known for reports of its serious psychiatric side effects. Questions about why it has been so widely and easily dispensed have been raised for some time. The director’s personal investigation seeks to understand why those affected have been left in the dark for so long. In doing so he uncovers some surprising truths about the powerful players involved in this controversial drug’s story.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: This show features some segments that didn’t fit in their respective episodes. We play around at the Pinball Museum in Las Vegas. Then, we salute the Commander in Chief at the Presidential Hall of Fame in Clermont, FL. Also, we’ll swim with real mermaids at Weeki Wachee Springs in Central Florida, and cheer on Teddy Ballgame at the Ted Williams Hitters Hall of Fame.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: O Say can you see? We’re in Baltimore, MD. We’ll learn about the Battle of Baltimore at Fort McHenry and the inspiration of the Star Spangled Banner. Then we dig deep into the history of Baltimore’s most famous resident, Edgar Allan Poe. We’ll sift through a huge collection of pop art and collectibles at the Geppi Museum, and learn about cracking codes at the National Cryptology museum.

programme.title: Nature’s Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature’s force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Nature’s Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature’s Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Running the Portland Canal from Prince Rupert to Alaska...and fishing Alaskan Halibut!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O’Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird’s that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He’s on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don’t have to. Along the way, he’s rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Join us as we explore the Gateway to India—Mumbai. From its early history, it’s many foreign occupations to the hustle and bustle of today. Bill tells Mumbai’s rich history is told through two of its most famous inhabitants, Gandhi and Kipling. We delve into the community of the Parsi faith and learn about their beliefs regarding the circle of life before heading to a little bit of heaven on earth, the coastal paradise of Goa. This hot spot for “in the know” travelers feature white, sandy beaches and is surrounded by tropical plant life. Bill introduces both the armchair and actual traveler to this incredible destination. We explore the Portuguese influence on Goa’s architecture and cuisine, tour the ghost city of Old Goa and explore Roman Catholic churches.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Where can you find literally hundreds of Jain Temples, a lost civilization and one of the top birding destinations in the world—the Bhavnagar region of course. Follow Bill as he attempts to climb 4000 steps to the great Jain temples of Palitana, floats through a lagoon full of flamingoes, egrets and cranes and learns about a kingdom lost to history.

programme.title: Journeys In Africa
programme.desc: Nicknamed the Garden of Eden, this volcanic caldera is home to over 25,000 big game animals. Here survival isn’t just a game—it’s a matter of life and death. You’ll witness one of the great acts of nature—buffalo, lion and hyena in a face-to-face struggle for dominance. Life in the crater can take surprising twists.

programme.title: Journeys In Africa
programme.desc: One of the most modern cities in Africa, Cape Town has something for everyone. We explore the city’s architecture, taste a little wine at nearby Vineyards and track down the only penguin species in Africa before reaching the fabled Cape of Good Hope…just a scenic drive outside the city proper.

Jo vetëm që ishte aventura e parë jashtë Amerikës qëndrore, por ishte edhe hera e parë që i shtyva kufijtë e guximit tim për të bërë shumë gjëra që nuk i kisha bërë kurrë më parë. Mposhta frikën time të gjatë të zhytjes me skafandër dhe e zhytjes në qiell. Shkova në xhunglën Meksikane, provova ushqimin pikant të rrugës, u ngjita në piramidën Maja në mes të pyllit Belizan dhe i dhashë të hajë lule një gomari ekstravagant...

New levels of expendable income mean the wallets of the wealthy elite are helping fund this rising beauty scene and creating a market for luxury goods for shrewd businesswoman Felicity Feng. Expats from everywhere are trying to gain a foothold in this blossoming city, but can they handle its lightning speed?

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: Forty years after the end of the conflict, unexploded bombs, secret tunnels and other vestiges of the long combat still exist in Vietnam.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It’s the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.desc: Paris and Berlin have developed and grown facing each other over four centuries of tumultuous historical relationships and mutual admiration. The architecture and urbanism bear witness of this complex and rich confrontation.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: ”D-DAY” - June 6th 1944: Normandy landings Personal and daily items such as helmets, badges, bullets, weapons, cans have been uncovered by recent archeological digs. These traces left behind by soldiers and civilians on the battle ground and findings of underground passages and blockhouses kept secret provide new insights into 2WW History.

programme.title: The Day When...
programme.desc: 16 czerwca 1940 r. w Bordeaux prawie nieznany deputowany postanowił publicznie zbuntować się przeciwko polityce przyjętej przez legalny rząd francuski, który przygotowywał się do wystąpienia o zawieszenie broni.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Kitesurfing is a sport that could not be better suited to an island location like Tahiti. With the sun, sand and an ocean breeze it is an ideal spot to spread your kite and surf.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Follow a group of extreme skiers as they explore Jackson Hole a Mecca for snow sports of all kind.

programme.title: What in the World?

programme.title: The PAST Hunters
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: The R.I.P. Files
programme.desc: The team explores St. Albans, a former sanitarium, and captures several shocking EVPs (spirit voices), including the one that became the title of this episode.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We visit Canada’s capital city on a hill in Ottawa, Ontario. We’ll sail down the famous Rideau Canal locks. We go deep into Ottawa’s cold war history at the Diefenbunker, as well as, explore Canada’s military history at the Canadian War Museum. Then we head up the Peace Tower and take a look at the library of Parliament. Finally, we learn about Canada’s first nation’s tribes at the Canadian History Museum.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We set sail to the land of the Norseman in Oslo, Norway. We’ll climb the fort walls at Akershus Fortress and discover the North and South Poles at the Fram Museum. Then, we’ll unearth ancient viking ship treasures at the Viking Ship Museum, and we’ll brave the open waters of the Pacific with Thor Heyerdahl at the Kon-tiki museum.

programme.title: Nature’s Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it’s also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth’s crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo’s Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Nature’s Force
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling for Chinook Salmon in Prince Rupert then making big run Southbound to Hartley Bay through Grenville Channel!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He’s there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He’s on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don’t have to. Along the way, he’s rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: The desert of Gujarat is hardly the place one expects to encounter a lion, but in the scrub forest of the region Bill does exactly that. Join him as he tracks the lion and many less dangerous creatures from spotted deer to owls and parrots. Around the campfire at night meet the local dance group who is preserving the traditional dances of the area people. A unique experience in a unique region.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Over the years, Bill has been able to find and film all of the great predators of India, but one—the wild Asiatic Dog or Dhole. These illusive and endangered canines have rarely been captured on camera. This is the last great wildlife challenge Bill has yet to conquer…Will he succeed?

programme.title: Journeys In Africa
programme.desc: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya and one of the most fascinating cities in Africa. On our visit we’ll see the colonial architecture of a bygone era and the ultra-modern side of town as well. We’ll learn the truth behind the “Out of Africa” story and our host gets eye-to-eye with some endangered giraffes.

programme.title: Journeys In Africa
programme.desc: Amboseli National Park has had several years of drought so we’re anxious to see if the famous elephant herds are healthy. Journeys takes to the air and ground to get a count of these incredible animals. Along the way, we visit the local Masai to see how they’re adjusting to encroaching civilization and we encounter buffalo, hippos and numerous bird species that make Amboseli so special.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Respect is something all skiing athletes must have. Respect for different cultures, lifestyles and their environment.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Several of the world’s best kayakers are led by South African legend, Steve Fisher, on a trip down one of the most difficult rivers in the world.

programme.title: Udhëtimi i Ëndrrave
programme.desc: Shkurti 2017 na pa të niseshim për një udhëtim ekspeditë përmes Skocisë, Polonisë, Francës, Meksikës, Belizës, dhe kthimi. Jo vetëm që ishte aventura e parë jashtë Amerikës qëndrore, por ishte edhe hera e parë që i shtyva kufijtë e guximit tim për të bërë shumë gjëra që nuk i kisha bërë kurrë më parë. Mposhta frikën time të gjatë të zhytjes me skafandër dhe e zhytjes në qiell. Shkova në xhunglën Meksikane, provova ushqimin pikant të rrugës, u ngjita në piramidën Maja në mes të pyllit Belizan dhe i dhashë të hajë lule një gomari ekstravagant...

programme.title: Of Boats and Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Ocean Odyssey: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: Whale Sharks: Gentle Giants introduces us to this amazing creature through scientists who are racing against time to save the species. Utilizing space-age technology from NASA and the Hubble Telescope, researchers are able to identify, catalogue and track individual sharks. In Mexico and remote Western Australia, whale shark tourism has proven to be both a blessing and a curse, as more and more boats vie for fewer animals. The program also features the remarkable story of shark cowboys who captured and transported 4 live whale sharks (in customized jumbo jets) to the Georgia Aquarium in Atlanta.

programme.title: Jonathan Bird’s Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan Bird është një nga operatorët më të mirë në botë të xhirimeve nënujore dhe një adhurues i pasionuar i thellësive të detit. Bashkohuni në një aventurë magjepsëse nënujore! Prezantuesi i programit, Jonathan Bird, zhytet dhe noton me balena, peshkaqenë, raja dhe lloje të ndryshme peshqish. Një takim emocionues i njeriut me botën nënujore!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Federica the turtle has arrived from Italy after a run in with a container ship. Loro Parque’s offered to be her ‘forever home’, but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? You’ve heard of a fish out of water - try a turtle!Esmeralda the iguana has a lumpy belly and Jorge the vet is worried. He’s hoping it’s a bounty of eggs but knows he shouldn’t count his iguanas before they hatch. Its fingers crossed for some scaly babies!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Rafa, the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque’, proudly leads the Foundation’s ornithological work, surrounded daily by parrots, puffins, and penguins. Meanwhile, Inaki faces a challenge: training Sue-Anne the anteater. Armed with vanilla yoghurt and patience, he’s hoping charm wins over stubbornness. Will she cooperate or snub his efforts?

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The mighty grizzly bear. The tiny powerful ant. The lunging inimitable crocodile. The indestructible rhino beetle. The hammering mantis shrimp. Which is the strongest of them all? Grizzly Bear – North America’s sub-alpine lands are ruled by its mightiest resident. Ants – With 12,000+ species, ants are fierce, territorial defenders, dispatching intruders with ease. Crocodile – Ancient rulers of rivers, crocodiles have the strongest bite force ever recorded. Rhino Beetle – This forest dweller can lift 850 times its own weight. Mantis Shrimp – With bizarre eyes and a punch as strong as a .22 bullet, it’s a tiny powerhouse.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The explosive sprinting Cheetah. The mighty bounding kangaroo. The horned and leaping wildebeest. The powerful and sure footed horse. Or the quick footed pronghorn. Which is the fastest over land? Cheetah – On Africa’s savannahs, predator and prey race at breathtaking speeds. Pronghorn – North America’s fastest, it sustains 60 km/h and can reach nearly 100. Wildebeest – Iconic endurance runners; calves walk within minutes and run within days. Kangaroo – Australia’s largest marsupial, alert and powerful, built for speed. Brumby – Wild horses, symbols of strength and freedom, gallop unbridled across Australia.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Deserts are dry, extreme places with little rain and few plants. Semi-deserts support more life, but survival is still tough. Animals adapt to heat and water scarcity—some drink rarely, get moisture from food, or travel far for water. Many seek shade, burrow, or are nocturnal. Scorpions, ancient and armored, use pincers and venom to survive. Rattlesnakes, fast and deadly, are feared—except by roadrunners, who hunt them. Desert life demands resilience, cleverness, and unique adaptations

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Nature’s battletanks—elephants, rhinos, and hippos—dominate Africa. Elephants survive on plants, yet lions and hyenas target the weak. Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators. In the Race of Life, strength and strategy are key to survival.

programme.title: Vrasësit e Afrikës
programme.desc: Miliona vjet pas epokës së dinosaurëve, në këtë planet vazhdojnë të enden gjigantët. Të krijuar për t’i rezistuar sprovave të kohës. Ata vijnë me trupa të stërmëdhenj. Lëkurë të trashë... Dhëmbë të mprehtë... Dhe agresivitet...

programme.title: Creative Killers - Open Ground
programme.desc: Across Africa, predators use the land to amplify their hunting skills. In Ndutu, cheetahs rely on speed and lookout points, even using fawns as bait. Lions, heavier and slower, depend on cover—gullies, marshes, forests—for ambushes. As the wildebeest migration arrives, we follow three characters through the rainy season, watching calves grow and predators adapt. The film explores how these hunters use the landscape, passing knowledge from one generation to the next.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: There’s more than just one creature lurking in this black lagoon. Here, in this bizarre netherworld between river and ocean, evolution has created a variety of freakish assassins, many of whom can strike in the blink of an eye. Witness the fast-paced, deadly action up close and in slow motion as our high-speed cameras capture sharp-shooting archerfish, African fish eagles, mantis shrimp, and other killers at work. Cutting-edge CGI details show just how they use their alien jaws, spear-like arms, and color-changing skin as weapons of underwater war.

programme.title: Ocean Odyssey: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: Sharks are BIG business in adrenaline eco-tourism. And some thrill seekers deliberately pursue close encounters with deadly sharks – without the protection of a cage. The bigger and more dangerous the shark, the better. Shark advocates Dr. Erich Ritter and Chuck Anderson have grave reservations about how far we are willing to go for a thrill. And they have intimate knowledge of the subject. Both men were brutally attacked by bull sharks. Shark Divers also examines the controversy surrounding a handful of high-profile attacks in 2008, including the first shark tourist killed while on a shark excursion.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Ubongo the gorilla has a foot injury, and treating a 400-pound patient takes serious skill. Meanwhile, Ester’s team unveils a coral farm—less cuddly, but just as vital. And in the summer heat, Hugo the sloth cools off with a slow-motion shower. From veterinary challenges to marine innovation and quirky animal moments, Loro Parque never stops surprising.

programme.title: The R.I.P. Files
programme.desc: The R.I.P. team visits the former home of the last woman hanged for witchcraft in Virginia and encounters the spirit of the still fiercely protective foreman of her farm.

programme.title: The R.I.P. Files
programme.desc: Major Graham’s Mansion, in the Virginia countryside, houses dark secrets that the team attempts to uncover.

programme.title: The PAST Hunters
programme.desc: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Get your kicks on Route 66 in Flagstaff, AZ. Duck and cover! We’re headed to the famous Barringer meteor crater outside of town. Then we scan the stars for heavenly bodies at Lowell Observatory. We’ll learn the history of the region at the Northern Arizona History Museum, and finally swing from their many ponderosa pines at Flagstaff Extreme adventure park.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We’re headed upstate to Albany and Saratoga Springs. We’ll take the Albany capital tour and see five former NY governors who would become US Presidents. Then, we’ll board the USS Slater and see how America defended its fleet against German U-boats in WWII. We’ll sample the mineral water in Saratoga Springs, and bet the farm at their famous thoroughbred raceway. Then, we’ll learn how important the Battle of Saratoga was for America’s future at Saratoga battlefield.

programme.title: Nature’s Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it’s maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Nature’s Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature’s heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let’s look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Humpback Whales, perfect water, summer sunshine and one of the finest fishing Chinook Salmon solo fishing days!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial – a predator – that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia – a Tiger Quoll – smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Just north of India is a land steeped in mystery—Nepal. Bill tours the city of Kathmandu, visits the World Heritage temple complexes, and walks along the city streets, where ancient and modern vie for space. We fly around Mount Everest, arguably the world’s most famous mountain, before heading into Chitwan National Park. In Chitwan, Bill searches for tigers from the back of an elephant and observes the myriad of wildlife that call the park home.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: There is no figure in Indian history that rivals Gandhi. Bill explores the land Gandhi called home and in the process, learns about the man himself. But Ahmedabad is more than Gandhi…its rich history and unusual architecture is revealed.

programme.title: Journeys In Africa
programme.desc: This is definitely the land of the elephant. Large herds of pachyderms roam this marshy park putting on a show for whoever wants to watch. But that’s not the only big boys of this park—buffalo, lion and a host of hoofed game make this a wonder to behold.

programme.title: Journeys In Africa
programme.desc: This under-visited, and far western Kenyan park area, is renowned for its giant flamingo gatherings that literally turn lakes pink. We explore these many parks on foot, in a safari vehicle and on horseback searching out the local legends that have marked this region the death zone. Our host faces imminent doom in three unique parks in this fast-paced episode.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Several of the world’s best kayakers are led by South African legend, Steve Fisher, on a trip down one of the most difficult rivers in the world.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: The best all-round snowboarder and skier in the world, explore and assault the southern alps of New Zealand looking for big air and beautiful light to kick off another winter season.

programme.title: Udhëtimi i Ëndrrave

Mposhta frikën time të gjatë të zhytjes me skafandër dhe e zhytjes në qiell. Shkova në xhunglën Meksikane, provova ushqimin pikant të rrugës, u ngjita në piramidën Maja në mes të pyllit Belizan dhe i dhashë të hajë lule një gomari ekstravagant...

programme.title: Of Boats and Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: The New Frontier
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer closer at nearby stars with ever more fidelity they are discovering planets; exo planets, worlds outside our own solar system. With technological advances and improved techniques scientists are discovering more and more worlds every day. With confidence scientists now calculated there could be as many as 40 billion Earth like planets in our Milky Way galaxy alone.

programme.title: The New Frontier
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe the further back in time we reach. What we see in the night sky is only a small percentage of the contents of the Universe, most is dark matter and dark energy we know it exists; however its nature eludes us for the moment.

programme.title: Everyday elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It’s cheesy and and eaten all over the world! You’ll learn how Dominick’s pizza became Domino’s pizza. And we all know how going to a circus wouldn’t be complete without fluffy sweet cotton candy! We’ll explain how this feathery goodness Spun to life! And all the spy action heroes use them, but where did the term gadget really come from?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Take a trip to the Jersey Shore and learn how one of its famous boardwalks helped to inspire the iconic board game of Monopoly. And how did a donkey and an elephant become associated with politics? Plus, what’s the difference between top grain leather and full grain leather?

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Nature’s Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature’s Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Alexander Graham Bell, inspired by a misunderstood German paper, aimed to send multiple tones through a wire—leading to the invention of the telephone. He discovered that voice vibrations vary electric current strength, enabling sound transmission. Though revolutionary, it took time for people to grasp its impact. Today, wireless calls dominate, yet still rely on Bell’s principles. As tech evolves, we may soon see phoneless communication.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
